messages.subject: Custom Shiny input/output binding
parts:
Hello,
I have a question about custom bindings. 
The following gist requires d3 and bootstrap.
https://gist.github.com/doesmindmatter/6210367

The goals of the shiny app are to:
1) open saved data file in shiny and use dataframe to make modifications to individual rows
2) Output binding: send row of data as array (message) to browser when selected from input drop-down list
3) modify array based on selections in browser d3
4) Input binding: send array back to server to amend dataframe row

There is something in the logic of the input/output that is eluding me. 
I'm concerned that my poor understanding of shiny reactivity and execution scheduling is adding to the problem.

Much thanks in advance,
-Ryan

messages.subject: Re: Custom Shiny input/output binding
parts:
Hi, Joe. Thanks for taking a look at this.
I tried in desperation to use isolate. I probably shouldn't use isolate at all.
The problem with the gist and demo are that message returns. 
However, the return message is just the same one that was previously sent as output.

To answer your implied question, the server file should contain the following two parts:
A) 
   BSub<-reactiveValues({input$blocksubj})
   output$d3io <- reactive({ShinyICs[BSub,]})
B)  
   ShinyICs[BSub,]<-reactiveValuesToList({input$d3io})

The message (an array) should only go to the client when there is A) input$blocksubj  
The message should return to the server only when there is B) input$d3io 

When the app begins there is also an error that the inputs are null.
In addition, I'm encountering error messages when I try only (the above) A&B with the shinyServer function.

Error in .getReactiveEnvironment()$currentContext() : 
Warning in read.table(file = file, header = header, sep = sep, quote = quote,  :
  incomplete final line found by readTableHeader on '/Users/r/Documents/Research/R_folder/ShinyApps/d3pass/www/ic_sheet.csv'
Operation not allowed without an active reactive context. (You tried to do something that can only be done from inside a reactive function.)

Thanks!!
-Ryan

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Custom Shiny input/output binding
parts: There are several invalid things about these three lines of code.

A) 
   BSub<-reactiveValues({input$blocksubj})
   output$d3io <- reactive({ShinyICs[BSub,]})
B)  
   ShinyICs[BSub,]<-reactiveValuesToList({input$d3io})

1. reactiveValues doesn't take an expression, it takes name-value pairs.
  2. You can't subset ShinyICs by a reactiveValues object, it would have to be something off of a reactiveValues object. I don't think that's what you mean either though.
  3. You can't call reactiveValuesToList() on input$d3io, as the latter is not a "reactive values" object.
Here's one possibility for what you meant instead:

A) 
   BSub<-reactive({input$blocksubj})
   output$d3io <- reactive({ShinyICs[BSub(),]})
B)  
   ShinyICs[BSub,]<-input$d3io # I actually have no idea what you mean here
